title: papaver armeniacum var. libanoticum
intro: Papaver armeniacum var. libanoticum, commonly known as Armenian poppy, is a plant species that belongs to the poppy family (Papaveraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including relief from inflammation, pain, and fever, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Armenian poppy are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as protopine and sanguinarine, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids. The plant's bioactive constituents are believed to contribute to its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, offering potential therapeutic benefits for various health conditions.
